title: Email Validation Module
description: Develop a Python module to validate email addresses using standard library tools, accompanied by a comprehensive pytest suite.

milestones.title: Initialize Module Structure
milestones.description: Create the project directory layout and scaffold email_validator.py with a module docstring and a stub function validate_email(address: str) -> bool.

validation_contract.command: python -c "from email_validator import validate_email; assert callable(validate_email)"
validation_contract.pass_criteria: Module imports successfully and exports a callable validate_email function.

milestones.title: Implement Core Validation Logic
milestones.description: Implement the validate_email function using the re module to check standard email format (local@domain.tld), handling None/empty inputs gracefully.

validation_contract.command: python -c "from email_validator import validate_email; assert validate_email('user@example.com') == True and validate_email('invalid') == False"
validation_contract.pass_criteria: Function correctly identifies a standard valid email and rejects a malformed string.

milestones.title: Develop Comprehensive Test Suite
milestones.description: Write tests/test_email_validator.py using pytest to cover valid formats, invalid formats, edge cases (long local parts, subdomains, special characters), and ensure full coverage.

validation_contract.pass_criteria: All pytest test cases pass without errors or failures.

global_constraints: All Python files must pass flake8 with max-line-length=120.
No external network calls during validation.
Use only Python standard library (e.g., re, typing) for implementation.
All file paths in commands and target_files must be relative to workspace/.
